task_title: journal은 run별 소유권과 동시 writer 잠금을 갖는다

physics_configuration.scene: tests/test_differentiable.py::project(steps=13), 2D 16 x 15, float64, epsilon 1.7, host banks, CPU tiles, slab width 4, temporal depth 3, restart_every_blocks 1
physics_configuration.ownership: owner.json with marker, run id, pid, host and start time, created O_EXCL; a holder child process; a dead pid from an exited child; locks from another host, unreadable and foreign
physics_configuration.integrity: the forward record after three blocks with one tampered description or file per instance: unknown dtype, wrong byte count, wrong shape, missing description, missing file, wrong checksum, description without a file name, wrong kind, wrong marker, empty array list
physics_configuration.terminal_states: one journal each: completed (full run), cancelled (cancel event during the second block), failed (transpose interrupted), partial (running status with a dead owner pid)
physics_configuration.durability: _move_file_ex recorded on Windows; os.open and os.fsync recorded on POSIX

reference_method: behavioural: exceptions and their messages, inspect_journal views, files on disk, and the rollback entries of a resumed run

observables.name: ownership_decision
observables.definition: the refusal message or the previous_state reported when a journal with an existing owner.json is opened

observables.name: integrity_reason
observables.definition: the RestartRecordDamaged reason naming the file and the failed check, as reported by _validate_record, _read_array, inspect_journal and the rollback entry

observables.name: terminal_state
observables.definition: state read by inspect_journal for each journal

observables.name: durability_calls
observables.definition: MoveFileExW flags per replaced file and directory on Windows; directory fsync calls on POSIX

acceptance_limits.ownership: a second writer is refused while the owner process lives (message names the run id and pid); a stale lock of a dead process on this host is taken over and previous_state is partial; locks from another host, unreadable locks and foreign markers are refused with the cause named and nothing is changed; after a terminal state the same run re-owns its journal on the next publish
acceptance_limits.integrity: each of the ten tampered instances is named with its file and check; the cheap checks (dtype, bytes, shape, missing file, description fields, kind, empty list) are reported by inspect_journal without reading the arrays, the array count and the checksum at load; every instance rolls back to the previous record and the resumed run completes; every written description carries file, shape, dtype, bytes equal to the file size and the SHA-256 of the file
acceptance_limits.terminal_states: completed, cancelled, failed and partial are four distinct states; a cancelled journal's records are valid and loadable by a reader that does not own the journal; a failed journal names the exception
acceptance_limits.durability: on Windows every JSON replacement uses MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING | MOVEFILE_WRITE_THROUGH and every record directory rename MOVEFILE_WRITE_THROUGH; on POSIX every rename is followed by an fsync of the journal directory; docs/STREAMED_RESTART.md states process-kill consistency (exercised) and power-loss durability (not exercised) as separate levels
acceptance_limits.source_of_limits: exact string, count and flag comparisons; no tolerance

applicable_scope: Durable restart journals on a local Windows volume: ownership by pid on one host, per-file integrity, terminal states, MoveFileExW write-through renames; the POSIX directory-fsync branch is not exercised here re-recorded on 9ba879241b39 for the release candidate.
